description: End-to-end workflow for reserving, booking, activating, and billing interconnect capacity between telecom operators, including validation, rating, dispute handling, and rollback.

partner_id.description: Unique identifier for the interconnect partner/operator (e.g., carrier code or internal ID)

capacity_request_id.description: Identifier for a provisional or requested interconnect capacity

reservation_id.description: Identifier for a reserved interconnect capacity slot prior to activation

booking_id.description: Identifier for a confirmed interconnect capacity booking

billing_account_id.description: Identifier for the billing account used to invoice interconnect charges

rate_plan_id.description: Identifier for a negotiated or catalog rate plan applied to the booking

circuit_group_id.description: Identifier for a group of physical or logical interconnect circuits

billing_cycle_id.description: Identifier for a specific billing cycle (e.g., 2024-09-M1)

dispute_case_id.description: Identifier for a billing dispute case related to a booking or billing cycle

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: search_interconnect_capacity
functions.description: Search available interconnect capacity slots and rate options between operators for a given period.

traffic_direction.description: Direction of traffic for the interconnect capacity

service_types.description: Types of services to be carried

functions.returns: Paginated list of available capacity offers including indicative rates and reference offer IDs.

functions.name: create_capacity_request
functions.description: Create a provisional interconnect capacity request based on a selected offer.

reference_offer_id.description: Identifier of the commercial/technical offer obtained from search or catalog

technical_profile.description: Technical configuration details required for provisioning

allowed_destinations.description: List of allowed destination countries or MCC/MNCs

commercial_terms_override.description: Optional overrides to the reference commercial offer (subject to approval)

functions.returns: New capacity_request_id with status (e.g., pending_approval) and a summary of requested parameters.

functions.name: validate_and_reserve_capacity
functions.description: Validate a capacity request against technical and commercial constraints and create a temporary reservation.

reserve_without_partner_ack.description: If true, reserves locally even if remote partner confirmation is pending

hold_duration_minutes.description: How long the reservation should be held before auto-expiry

override_rate_plan_id.description: Optional rate_plan_id to apply instead of the reference offer's default

functions.returns: Reservation result including reservation_id, validation reports (technical/commercial), and hold expiry timestamp.

functions.name: confirm_interconnect_booking
functions.description: Confirm a reserved capacity and create a final interconnect booking with assigned circuits and rate plan.

partner_confirmation.description: Confirmation details from the remote partner

circuit_groups.description: List of circuit groups to be bound to this booking

rate_plan_id.description: Rate plan to be associated with this booking; defaults to reservation's rate plan if omitted

billing_account_id.description: Billing account that will own the charges; overrides request-level account if provided

auto_activate.description: If true, booking moves to active at start time without manual activation

functions.returns: Created booking_id with final commercial terms, circuit assignments, and initial lifecycle status (e.g., scheduled or active).

functions.name: get_booking_status
functions.description: Retrieve current lifecycle, technical, and billing status of an interconnect booking.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Booking lifecycle status (e.g., scheduled, active, suspended, terminated), technical details, and optional billing summary.

functions.name: modify_or_cancel_reservation
functions.description: Modify key attributes of a reservation or cancel it before confirmation.

notify_partner.description: Whether the remote partner should be notified of the modification/cancellation

functions.returns: Updated reservation details or cancellation confirmation, including any partner notification status.

functions.name: suspend_or_terminate_booking
functions.description: Suspend (temporary) or terminate (permanent) an active or scheduled interconnect booking.

effective_time_utc.description: When the action should take effect; defaults to immediate if omitted

billing_treatment.description: How to handle billing around suspend/terminate events

functions.returns: Lifecycle change acknowledgement with updated status and any scheduled suspension/termination timestamps.

functions.name: attach_rate_plan_to_booking
functions.description: Attach or update a rate plan and rating parameters for a booking, supporting mid-term changes.

effective_start_utc.description: When this rate plan should start applying

effective_end_utc.description: Optional end time, typically on rate plan migration

rating_parameters.description: Additional parameters used by rating engine

rate_override_per_minute.description: Optional override rate per minute in plan currency

commitment_levels.description: Volume or spend commitments defining tiers

audit.description: Audit details for the rate plan change

functions.returns: Updated booking rating configuration including historical and future rate plan segments.

functions.name: generate_provisional_billing_cycle
functions.description: Generate a provisional billing cycle for one or more bookings, aggregating usage and recurring charges.

booking_filters.description: Optional filters to limit which bookings are included

include_unrated_usage.description: If true, include usage records that could not be rated, flagged for manual review

recalculate_existing_charges.description: If true, rerun rating for already generated cycles (for what-if scenarios)

correlation_id.description: External reference for tracing this billing run

functions.returns: Provisional billing_cycle_id with summarized charges per booking/partner and a list of rating anomalies if any.

functions.name: get_billing_cycle_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information about a billing cycle, including charges, adjustments, and status.
functions.returns: Billing cycle status (draft, finalized, disputed), totals, and optionally detailed line items grouped as requested.

functions.name: raise_or_update_dispute
functions.description: Create or update a dispute case on specific bookings or billing cycle charges, including line-level references.

billing_cycle_id.description: Billing cycle that contains the disputed charges

dispute_details.description: Details of the dispute when creating or updating

line_item_references.description: Specific rated line items or CDR batches in dispute

supporting_documents.description: References to documents (e.g., CDR extracts, emails)

status_update.description: Used for update/close operations to modify status and resolution

functions.returns: Dispute case record including dispute_case_id, current status, history of updates, and financial impact summary.

functions.name: rollback_billing_or_booking_state
functions.description: Perform a controlled rollback for billing cycles or booking states in case of critical errors.

rating_run_correlation_id.description: Identifier of a rating/billing run, used when rollback_scope is 'rating_run'

target_state.description: Target state or snapshot reference to restore to

rollback_to_timestamp_utc.description: Restore state as of this time if snapshot_id is not used

impact_analysis_only.description: If true, simulate rollback and return impact report without applying changes

safety_checks.description: Additional controls to avoid corrupting state

functions.returns: Rollback result or impact analysis, including affected bookings, billing cycles, financial deltas, and any blocked-rollback reasons.

functions.name: list_bookings_and_reservations
functions.description: List reservations and bookings for a partner or account with flexible filters for operational oversight.

time_range.description: Filter by activation or creation time

functions.returns: Paginated list of reservations and/or bookings with key attributes, suitable for dashboards and operational review.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import interconnect booking entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many interconnect booking entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many interconnect booking entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_bulk_export
functions.description: Export interconnect booking entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across interconnect booking entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for interconnect booking events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for interconnect booking notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more interconnect booking entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to interconnect booking on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a interconnect booking operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending interconnect booking change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending interconnect booking approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a interconnect booking entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a interconnect booking entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a interconnect booking entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a interconnect booking entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for interconnect booking activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a interconnect booking view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to interconnect booking entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given interconnect booking payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a interconnect booking entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: interconnect_booking_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a interconnect booking entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
